activity_summary: At supper you paid threepence and reported that the yard had clapped the cook. You did not restage it. Mistress Ansell ruled on a play she had not seen, and the firing stayed off. The wage reckoning was not repeated as a sum.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported the line once and paid threepence.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Refused a play she had not seen and took the threepence.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked whether the pie was a word or a thing, and got both answers kept apart.
